run_DETR_training: run the DETR transformer detector training on a COCO dataset with configurable backbone and epochs
run_DETR_evaluation: run evaluation of a trained DETR model on a validation dataset and save bbox results
build_args_parser: build an argparse parser with all DETR training hyperparameters including backbone, transformer, and loss options
resume_DETR_training: resume DETR training from a saved checkpoint file with optimizer and lr scheduler state
configure_DETR_distributed_training: configure DETR for distributed multi-GPU training with configurable world size and batch size
